# eon_resources (Data Source)

Retrieves a filtered list of inventory resources in the Eon project. Use this data source to resolve Eon resource IDs for `eon_restore_job`, `eon_resource_snapshots`, backup exclusions, and classification overrides.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: List all inventory resources in the project
data "eon_resources" "all" {}

# Example: Resolve an Eon resource ID by cloud-provider resource ID
data "eon_resources" "by_provider_id" {
  provider_resource_ids = ["i-1234567890abcdef0"]
}

# Example: Filter by resource type and backup status
data "eon_resources" "protected_ec2" {
  resource_types  = ["AWS_EC2"]
  backup_statuses = ["PROTECTED"]
}

output "first_resource_id" {
  description = "Eon-assigned ID of the first listed resource, if any"
  value       = try(data.eon_resources.all.resources[0].id, null)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `account_ids` (List of String) Optional filter: match resources whose cloud-provider-assigned source account ID is in this list.
- `backup_statuses` (List of String) Optional filter: match resources whose backup status is in this list (for example `PROTECTED`, `EXCLUDED_FROM_BACKUP`).
- `cloud_providers` (List of String) Optional filter: match resources whose cloud provider is in this list. Possible values: `AWS`, `AZURE`, `GCP`.
- `environments` (List of String) Optional filter: match resources whose environment classification is in this list (for example `PROD`, `STAGE`, `DEV`).
- `ids` (List of String) Optional filter: match resources whose Eon-assigned ID is in this list.
- `provider_resource_ids` (List of String) Optional filter: match resources whose cloud-provider-assigned ID is in this list.
- `resource_names` (List of String) Optional filter: match resources whose display name is in this list.
- `resource_types` (List of String) Optional filter: match resources whose type is in this list (for example `AWS_EC2`, `AWS_RDS`).

### Read-Only

- `resources` (Attributes List) List of inventory resources matching the filters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--resources))
- `total_count` (Number) Number of resources returned.

<a id="nestedatt--resources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `resources`

Read-Only:

- `backup_status` (String) Backup protection status of the resource.
- `cloud_provider` (String) Cloud provider. Possible values: `AWS`, `AZURE`, `GCP`.
- `created_time` (String) Date and time the resource record was created in Eon.
- `data_classes` (List of String) Effective data-classification labels, when present.
- `discovered_time` (String) Date and time the resource was first discovered.
- `environment` (String) Effective environment classification, when present.
- `id` (String) Eon-assigned resource ID.
- `latest_snapshot_time` (String) Date and time of the resource's latest Eon snapshot.
- `oldest_snapshot_time` (String) Date and time of the resource's first Eon snapshot.
- `provider_account_id` (String) Cloud-provider-assigned source account ID.
- `provider_resource_id` (String) Cloud-provider-assigned resource ID.
- `region` (String) Region the resource is hosted in.
- `resource_name` (String) Resource display name.
- `resource_type` (String) Resource type (for example `AWS_EC2`, `AWS_RDS`).
- `subnets` (List of String) Subnets the resource belongs to, when applicable.
- `tags` (Map of String) Resource tags as key-value pairs.
- `vpc` (String) VPC the resource is in, when applicable.
